transcript.t: Amy, look at the big blades on the hill.
They are wind turbines. They make electricity.
Is wind a useful type of energy?
Yes. It is clean, and it will not run out.
Do we also use the sun?
Yes. Solar power gives light and heat.
Oil and coal will run out one day.
So we need more clean energy.
